command: for c in ai-chatbot-saas-worker-1 acs-a5-qa-worker-1; do docker inspect $c --format '{{.Name}} Memory={{.HostConfig.Memory}} NanoCpus={{.HostConfig.NanoCpus}} PidsLimit={{.HostConfig.PidsLimit}} Init={{.HostConfig.Init}}'; done; docker stats --no-stream --format '{{.Name}} {{.MemUsage}} pids={{.PIDs}}' acs-a5-qa-worker-1; grep -nE 'mem_limit|cpus|pids_limit|^  [a-z-]+:$' docker-compose.yml docker-compose.prod.yml
